# Edusphere Academy (Malaysia)

> Skills training academy in Taman Perling, Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. Hands-on certificate courses in nursing aide, professional caregiving, hospital & healthcare administration, and barista arts.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my
- Email: info@edusphereacademy.com.my
- Phone: +60 17-755 8196
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/60177558196
- Address: 26 Jalan Camar 1, Taman Perling, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00am–6:00pm

## Courses offered

### Advanced Certificate in Nursing Aide
- Duration: 36 hours (12 weeks, weekend classes)
- Fee: MYR 1,500 total (MYR 500/month x 3 months)
- Modules: First Aid + CPR/AED, Wound Care Support, Physiotherapy Support Skills
- Career paths: Nursing Aide, Healthcare Assistant, Patient Care Assistant, Home Care Aide
- URL: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/advanced-certificate-in-nursing-aide

### Advanced Certificate in Professional Caregiving (Elderly, Autism & Child Care)
- Duration: 36 hours (12 weeks, weekend classes)
- Fee: MYR 1,500 total (MYR 500/month x 3 months)
- Modules: Elderly Care, Autism Care, Child Care
- Career paths: Professional Caregiver, Elderly Care Assistant, Special Needs Support Aide, Childcare Support Assistant
- URL: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/advanced-certificate-in-professional-caregiving

### Advanced Certificate in Hospital & Healthcare Administration
- Duration: 36 hours (12 weeks, weekend classes)
- Fee: MYR 1,500 total (MYR 500/month x 3 months)
- Modules: Healthcare Operations, Patient Administration, Medical Records & IT Systems
- Career paths: Hospital Administrative Assistant, Patient Service Coordinator, Clinic Front Office Executive
- URL: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/hospital-healthcare-administration

### Certificate in Barista Arts
- Duration: 36 hours (12 weeks, weekend classes)
- Fee: MYR 1,500 total (MYR 500/month x 3 months)
- Modules: Espresso Extraction, Milk Texturing & Latte Art, Cafe Service & Workflow
- Career paths: Barista, Cafe Service Crew, Coffee Specialist
- URL: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/barista-arts
